verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe scoping each end-user/tenant to a container tag and deleting that container's entire content via API/console to satisfy a deletion request (per-entity and full erasure use cases), which directly matches part of the story. However, there is no documented single-memory deletion endpoint or workflow (e.g., delete-by-memory-ID) in the evidence pack — only container-level (bulk) deletion is shown. Missing for 10: explicit single-memory delete API/example, confirmation of granular per-memory erasure, and independent/hands-on verification that deletion actually removes data from all indexes.
